text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса has finished up today's
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks a ton! Now I can really get the
sweat
going!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do some more trainin' on my
own!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My papa always says the most important
part of
getting stronger is...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: That's why I gotta train even harder!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: When you put it like that, I've got to join you!
In that case, you should get some rest.

text_block_list.text: That's why I gotta train even harder!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: When you put it like that, I've got to join you!
In that case, you should get some rest.

text_block_list.text:
Really?! I knew you had the same
passion as I do
runnin' through your
veins!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get as fired up as the
red-hot
evening sun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But I don't wanna take a
break!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I wanna get faster... faster! And I can't
do that
without training!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
Doesn't that mean that taking a break is the
most difficult path for you right now?

text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Well, if I'm gonna keep walkin'
the most
difficult path...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: All right, understood! I'll take a break!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This is what I have to do to spread my
wings for
the world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We do some additional training until the
sun goes
down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
